def factor_asymmetry_simplified_v2(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy['close']
    returns = close / close.shift(1) - 1
    window = 20
    up_rets = returns.where(returns > 0, 0)
    down_rets = returns.where(returns < 0, 0)
    up_count = up_rets.ne(0).rolling(window).sum()
    down_count = down_rets.ne(0).rolling(window).sum()
    up_semi = np.sqrt((up_rets**2).rolling(window).sum() / up_count.replace(0, np.nan))
    down_semi = np.sqrt((down_rets**2).rolling(window).sum() / down_count.replace(0, np.nan))
    factor = np.log(down_semi / up_semi.replace(0, np.nan))
    factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    factor = factor.rolling(3).mean().fillna(0)
    df_copy['factor_asymmetry_simplified_v2'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_asymmetry_simplified_v2']
